title: First-Principles Electronegativity Scale from the Atomic Mean Inner Potential
summary: Electronegativity is a cornerstone of chemical intuition, essential for rationalizing bonding, reactivity, and material properties. However, prevailing scales remain empirically derived, often relying on parameterized models or composite physical quantities. In this work, we introduce a universal electronegativity scale founded on the atomic mean inner potential (AMIP), also known as the average Coulomb potential, a fundamental, quantum-mechanical property accessible through both first-principles computation and electron-scattering experiments.
